arguments.body: Hello, thanks for reporting this. Sorry, our system wrongly logged it as a fridge problem; it is now logged as a front door repair and treated as urgent. Until it is fixed, please close the door gently rather than slamming it, and keep people away from any glass if it looks cracked. A few quick questions: 1) Does the front door lock and secure properly when shut, so the flat is safe tonight? 2) Is any glass in the door cracked or loose? 3) Does the back door need the same repair? 4) Any access details, such as entry codes, alarms or pets? We are asking the landlord for approval now, and you will hear from us again by tomorrow.
